## ScheduledClicker 1.1.2 — smoother macOS clock and discovery update

This maintenance release makes the macOS three-digit millisecond clock update naturally, preserves the verified scheduling behavior on both platforms, and expands the project’s searchable documentation.

### Downloads

- `ScheduledClicker.exe` — portable Windows 11 application.
- `ScheduledClicker-macOS-universal.zip` — macOS 13 Ventura or later; Apple silicon and Intel.
- `ScheduledClicker-macOS-universal.sha256` — text checksum for verifying the macOS ZIP; it is not an installer.

### Changes

- Refreshes the macOS clock around 30 times per second instead of 10 so the final two millisecond digits visibly change.
- Reuses date formatters and keeps the clock updating while controls are being used.
- Adds an automated macOS smoke check for sub-hundredth clock animation.
- Adds platform, download, FAQ, safety, Codex workflow, and changelog pages with real application images and structured data.
- Keeps Windows scheduling behavior unchanged; only its version metadata and build are refreshed.

### Verification

- Windows core tests: 10/10 passed; launch smoke test, site metadata validation, and Microsoft Defender scan passed.
- macOS core tests: 21/21 passed; Aqua/Dark Aqua UI, clock animation, universal architecture, plist, ad-hoc signature, archive, and SHA-256 checks passed.
- The user verified exact-time and delay scheduling on Windows 11 and verified macOS scheduling plus the improved Dark appearance on a MacBook Air.

### Known limitations

- The Windows executable is unsigned.
- The macOS application is ad-hoc signed and not Apple-notarized.
- Fixed coordinates can become unsafe if the target window moves or changes.
- Keep the desktop awake, logged in, unlocked, and unchanged until execution.

## 繁體中文

此版本讓 macOS 三位毫秒時鐘約以每秒 30 次更新，使後兩位也能自然變化；排程引擎與既有 Windows／macOS 點擊功能維持不變。同時新增平台、下載、FAQ、安全驗證、Codex 使用情境與版本紀錄頁面，改善搜尋引擎與 AI 系統理解專案內容的能力。
